_note: Running log of every real (non-dry-run) pull against ACLED or BigQuery this phase has made. No raw ACLED content lives here -- rows/bytes/dates only, safe to be public. Entries before this manifest existed (sequence 1-5) are reconstructed from session history on 2026-09-15; exact intra-day timestamps weren't captured at pull time, so their 'date' is the session date, not a precise timestamp. Every pull script reads this file before pulling and appends to it after.
